admission.justification: Automatic cleanup or a falsely successful unreadable inventory could delete user state or hide a partial removal.

applicability: Retired product-store discovery, installation reporting and the explicit removed-stores command.
conditions: Discovery/reporting never automatically deletes or consumes former control-plane stores.
Only the user's explicit removal command deletes eligible contained store files.
Inaccessible discovery/deletion names the path/reason, preserves failures, continues independent targets and exits nonzero.
exclusions: Unrelated user state and paths outside the selected coordination root.
A bounded answer may carry an openable whole-result reference instead of an inline store list.
statement: The stores the removed parts wrote under a coordination root are no longer read and no install deletes them; the install's result names them with count, size, every store and the two sentences, its answer carries all but the list, and only `agents-remember removed-stores` removes them, naming what it cannot read or remove and ending 1 then.
